But the headline interpretation is wrong: the direct effect of switching proxy tier is ~0.3pp per book for every vehicle, while the reported reversal comes from the simulator taking a different discrete trade path (hundreds of different BAL trades, 13-28pp single-year book swings) once cash differs slightly. The overlay cross-check that PREREG promised but the REPORT omitted shows A>D at both tiers with no reversal.
